semantics.cpu: delta cumulative CPU seconds / covered seconds; cores, not percent
semantics.memory: time-weighted left-held bytes, bounded by maximum gauge age
semantics.network: delta cumulative bytes / covered seconds; not HTTP request rate
semantics.counter_intervals: only pairs observed by bucket end; reset and excessive-gap intervals excluded
semantics.mean: covered-time-weighted mean over the same valid buckets for all metrics
semantics.slope: OLS over actual bucket-end minutes; cores/minute and bytes/minute
semantics.labels: none; feature eligibility does not establish healthy or precursor labels
semantics.availability: source observation times only; arrival times are not supplied
